title: My Company Of One Story - Episode 1 Intro
content:
<html><head></head><body>Welcome to this new blog-series of mine where I want to invite you to follow my path as one-man-company. I want to share with you how I survive working on my own, freelancing, building products, and how I try to follow my business dreams. This is episode number one, where I give you an overview of what I do and what to expect.
            </body></html>
